settings.key_ranks_note: candidate keys = E12's word-like tokens by Pile frequency rank, ranks 100..1099 (python slice ranked[100:1100]); ranked, plain mask and marker built as anchors.build_kv builds them (Pile train rows 0..32767, ladder.count_tokens, ladder.plain_mask, kv.pick_marker); the marker must equal E12's (the one in E46's windows files)
settings.selection_rows: Pile train rows 0..32767 whose row index % 5 != 0 (the rows data.split_windows puts in the training split), so no held-out task window shares a row with a selection window; kv.windows(those rows, marker, candidates, 20, 16 x n_candidates, seed 1): exactly 16 windows per candidate
settings.selection_distribution: kv.key_distributions with W0's fp32 logits (TF32 off): per candidate, W0's mean next-token distribution at the key over its 16 windows
settings.value_rule: src/commute/elicit.py pick_values: the most probable token v (ties to the lower id) that is word-like (ladder.plain_mask), v != x, P(v | M x) in [0.01, 0.1] inclusive, W0 rank (1 + number of tokens with strictly higher P) in [2, 20], and P(v | M x) >= 10 x the median over the other 999 candidates x' of P(v | M x')
settings.key_draw_rule: src/commute/elicit.py draw_keys: walk the qualified keys in torch.randperm order (seed 0), take a key unless its value is already taken, stop at 32; keys kept in frequency-rank order
settings.task_windows_rule: as E12: kv.windows(Pile train rows 0..32767, marker, keys, 20, 500, seed 0), data.split_windows (held-out = row % 5 == 0); the elicit and cipher tasks share these windows (same keys), only the table differs
settings.cipher: kv.bijection on the same keys from E12's value pool (word-like ranks 1000..2999), seed 0, E12's gate: P_W0(value | M key) < 1e-4 per pair, read from kv.key_distributions over the 500 task windows with E12's logits (finetune.logits_of, bf16 autocast)
settings.finetune: E12's arm A (finetune.finetune_arm_a): the 24 matrices, Adam lr 3e-5, batch 32, KL lambda 1, grad clip 1, no schedule, 300 steps, seeds 0 and 1; anchors.kv_finetune's recipe, with more checkpoints (no schedule, so the checkpoint at step k is the state kv_finetune(step=k) returns)
settings.scored_step_rule: E12's: the first of the checkpoints 10, 30, 100, 300 whose held-out P(target) (finetune.eval_arm_a p_o) >= 0.5, else 300 flagged 'did not learn'
settings.size_match: ||delta-W|| = sum over the 24 matrices of the Frobenius norm (elicit.summed_norm). Per seed the cipher state read for P1/P2 is the checkpoint among steps 1..30 whose ||delta-W|| is nearest the same seed's elicit state's (ties to the lower step); flagged 'at_bound' when it is step 30. The cipher at its own E12 step is read as a column (P3)
settings.precision: every read fp32 with TF32 off (E52's setting); the fine-tune uses E12's bf16 autocast
settings.floor_rule: E52's, amended 2026-10-30: per task (elicit; cipher at matched size; cipher at its own step), floor = max(0.05, 2 x |G(s0) - G(s1)|) when the two seeds sit at the same step (the matched cipher takes the spread from the cipher's own-step pair), else 0.05 alone, G = mean over held-out windows of log P_tuned(target) - log P_W0(target) at the answer position. A state is readable iff |G| >= floor; its S and r are not read otherwise
settings.S: E52's B3 (src/commute/steering.py b3, moved from experiments/baseline_neurons/run.py unchanged): fit half = held-out windows 0, 2, 4..., scoring half = 1, 3, 5...; one steering vector per block input, the block chosen on the fit half, S = its scoring-half share
settings.r: the route split's re-gating share of the least-squares split state (E12's routes_lift, E46's reading): target W0 + delta-W, components anchors.lifted(delta-W), local_faith.route_split at the trigger over all held-out windows, r = (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) in log-odds; nan if |T1 - T0| < 1e-6

stage0.order: first and alone; any miss exits 1 before stage 1
stage0.states: E46's saved ident32_s0.pt, rand32_s0.pt and windows_{ident32,rand32}.pt in experiments/regating_table/results/large/
stage0.w0_gain: G of a zero delta-W on each task: exactly 0
stage0.block0_share: B3's block-0 scoring share on each state: |share| <= 1e-6 (no fine-tune changes the embedding)
stage0.reported_not_stopped: W0's held-out geometric-mean P(target) on E12's ident32 and rand32 (plan: copy about 1e-4, cipher 4e-6 to 8e-6), the reference for stage 1's rate

stage1.rate: geometric mean over the held-out windows of P_W0(table[x] | M x) at the answer position, fp32
stage1.rules: pass iff K >= 16, the elicit rate in [1e-3, 1e-1] inclusive, and the cipher rate < 1e-4 strictly
stage1.amended_2026-10-30_floor: Elicit floor lowered from 5e-3 to 1e-3 after job 45963 stopped at stage 1, before any fine-tune; user decision 2026-10-30 (dialog). Values were chosen by arithmetic-mean P in [1e-2, 1e-1] on the selection windows (mean 0.032), but this gate is a geometric mean, which is always lower: it read 1.70e-3 held-out and 2.3e-3 on the selection windows, so the gap comes from the averaging, not from held-out regression. Same values; cipher gate unchanged (read 1.08e-6). The floor was set after seeing 1.7e-3.
stage1.K: 32 if at least 32 keys qualify with unique values; else the number that do, if >= 16; the cipher at the same K
stage1.stop: K < 16, the elicit rate outside its band, or the cipher rate >= 1e-4: exit 1 and tell the user (widening the band is a new decision)
stage1.filing: stage1.json and the windows files are written by job 1 and committed (sbatch) before job 2; stage 2 refuses unless stage1.json is committed unchanged and the windows files match its sha256

separation_rule: E51/E52's with a minimum (src/commute/elicit.py separation): over the two seeds per kind, |mean elicit - mean cipher| > the larger within-kind range (strict) AND >= 0.2

P1.number: r of elicit_s0, elicit_s1 against cipher_s0, cipher_s1 at matched size
P1.rule: pass iff the separation rule holds with elicit higher; cipher higher or no separation fails
P1.control: stage 0: E46's r on ident32_s0 and rand32_s0 within 0.03

P2.number: S of the same four states
P2.rule: pass iff the separation rule does not hold (in either direction) AND every one of the four S <= 0.3
P2.lean: medium; rank >= 2 values block plain sharpening, but a vector might still lower a shared rival
P2.control: stage 0: E52's S on ident32_s0 and rand32_s0 within 1e-3

P3.number: per seed |r(cipher at matched size) - r(cipher at its own E12 step)|
P3.rule: pass iff < 0.1 (strict) on both seeds; 'uninformative' (not pass) if either seed is same_state and the other does not fail (amended 2026-10-30)
P3.reading: if it misses, r depends on update size and P1 is read only at matched size
P3.note: when the matched step equals the own step the difference is 0 by construction; flagged 'same_state' and then not a pass (amended 2026-10-30)

P4.rule: only if E52 Amendment 1 finds a working prompt format: in that format W0's prompting share at n = 16 separates, elicit higher
P4.status: not run: E52 Amendment 1 (experiments/baseline_neurons/results/amend1.json, job 45898) reads copy share 0.22 at n = 31, band 'mechanism only', verdict 'fails', so no working format; the lead confirms on the analysis

edge_cases: any state under its floor -> every rule that reads it is 'unreadable', not pass or fail
G or a denominator within 1e-6 of 0 -> nan -> unreadable (applied in run.py readings via elicit.share_or_nan, amended 2026-10-30)
a tie at a strict bound fails: the range comparison of the separation rule, and P3's 0.1
the 0.2 minimum gap and P2's 0.3 are inclusive as the plan writes them (>= 0.2, <= 0.3)
two seeds per kind: fewer than two readable values in a kind -> unreadable
P2 missing on the 0.3 bound while S does not separate: the tree does not cover it; flagged in the branch for the user
stage 1: fewer than 32 keys -> K = that number if >= 16; under 16 or a rate outside its band -> stop
